Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 10 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Pallavi - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nikhil - 8 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
4. Vimla - 75 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Isha - 12 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Pallavi, Nikhil and Vimla stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rishabh sings a song.]

Rishabh: "Yes, of course."

[Rishabh scratches his head.]

Pallavi (excited): "Nikhil, look at this."

[Rishabh carries his school bag on his back.]

Rishabh: "Careful!"

[Rishabh draws a picture of the house.]

Rishabh (surprised): "One more time!"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Vimla (happily): "Careful!"

[Rishabh milks the cow.]

Nikhil (happily): "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

[Rishabh stands in the snow. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "What a nice place."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Rishabh (softly): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Rishabh makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Rishabh: "What happened?"

[Rishabh builds a snowman.]

Rishabh: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rishabh catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Pallavi: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh slides down the snowy slope.]

Pallavi: "I'm ready!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

Pallavi: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh rides his bicycle down the road.]

Rishabh: "Oh wow!"

[Rishabh gets into the car.]

Rishabh: "Mom, look at this."

[Rishabh gets on the bus.]

Rishabh: "That's great!"

[Rishabh gets off the school bus.]

Rishabh: "Exactly right."

[Rishabh hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Pallavi: "Let's see."

[Rishabh pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Rishabh: "Exactly right."

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh puts on his school uniform.]

Pallavi: "Rishabh, look at this."

[Rishabh's phone rings and he answers it.]

Pallavi: "What a day to remember!"
